// Covers padding/margin family shorthand:
//   px-4 py-4 -> p-4
//   pl-2 pr-2 -> px-2
//   mt-3 mb-3 -> my-3

export function PaddingShorthand() {
    return <div className="px-4 py-4 text-base">all sides padding</div>;
                           ~~~~ ~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: Classnames 'px-4, py-4' could be replaced by the 'p-4' shorthand!
}

export function PaddingXShorthand() {
    return <div className="pl-2 pr-2 bg-white">left+right padding</div>;
                           ~~~~ ~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: Classnames 'pl-2, pr-2' could be replaced by the 'px-2' shorthand!
}

export function MarginYShorthand() {
    return <div className="mt-3 mb-3 block">top+bottom margin</div>;
                           ~~~~ ~~~~
!!! tailwindcss/enforces-shorthand: Classnames 'mt-3, mb-3' could be replaced by the 'my-3' shorthand!
}

// Covers padding/margin family shorthand:
//   px-4 py-4 -> p-4
//   pl-2 pr-2 -> px-2
//   mt-3 mb-3 -> my-3

export function PaddingShorthand() {
    return <div className="p-4 text-base">all sides padding</div>;
}

export function PaddingXShorthand() {
    return <div className="px-2 bg-white">left+right padding</div>;
}

export function MarginYShorthand() {
    return <div className="my-3 block">top+bottom margin</div>;
}
